answer: Each agent holds a cryptographic mirror of its reputation score, posted to a decentralized ledger and signed with a unique quill‑derived key pair. When a new agent joins it must bond a falcon‑priced stake locked in a smart contract; auditors randomly verify identities and any duplicate triggers an automatic slash of that stake. Because each slash forfeits the falcon‑scale bond, an attacker must spend proportional collateral for every forged identity, quickly exhausting resources.
